modifications: Separated decision serving from the causal LM adapter registry, scheduler, and request lifecycle
Reused mlx2's existing Qwen3.5/Qwen3.8 text trunk and strict indexed-artifact loading instead of copying the upstream backbone or vision implementation
Preserved the published joint-schema prompt, question and option spans, lexical projection, evidence routing, joint field decoder, and score mapping
Added a backend-neutral typed decision request contract and an expandable decision runtime registry
Added a standalone /v1/systemone service with Host, Origin, and optional API-key gates
Added implemented, qualified, selected, and observed-used route fields; qualification is installed only from an exact validated receipt
Rejected images, videos, generation, non-unit temperature, unknown artifact keys, unsupported topology, and incomplete head geometry
Applied mlx2 tokenizer-integrity repair after local tokenizer loading and exposed its receipt in status
Added absolute HTTP header/body deadlines and strict finite JSON, Unicode, nesting, and question-count validation
Bound Hub-cache route receipts to detected 40-hex revisions and declared Hub blob filename identities without claiming payload re-hashing; labelled non-Hub fingerprints as layout metadata
Required the trained lexical LM head and rejected both configured and indexed MTP state before loading
Capped rendered state at 1 MiB, choices at 255, score levels at 10, and questions at 64; refused reserved model-control tokens and truncation that would erase the entire nonempty state
Dropped the artifact vision tower before materialization; the first slice is text-only Clef-Flash 9B and Clef 27B
Added revision-bound production qualification receipts that fail startup closed on source, producer, runtime, artifact, or serving-setting drift
Added bounded Prometheus request, refusal, failure, token, latency, load, inflight, CPU, memory, route, and qualification telemetry

validation.artifact_validation: CPU synthetic indexed-artifact and fail-closed topology tests
validation.prompt_validation: CPU exact schema layout, canonical JSON, span, option ordering, truncation, and refusal tests
validation.head_validation: Tiny MLX finite-output and shape test

validation.basic_candidate_qualification: private-main candidate run passed 34/34 HTTP functional checks; source-bound evidence omitted from the public projection
validation.qualification: private-main source 07178885cc7bd8f52fe7a93682528c32a0e9953f8ff7172b3bedb89b1aeadf0b passed 13/13 production gates for Clef-Flash 9B revision 8f9beb2e63474d547c70810b41b468d3b4a84932; this public projection has a different source identity, includes no receipt, and is unqualified until independently rerun
validation.performance: not measured; recorded Prometheus values are uncontrolled qualification observations
